summary: The requested SSH policy was installed and reloaded, but it excluded the provider transport account `antrieb` from `remote-access`. Subsequent node commands are rejected, so final verification and the mandatory restart protocol could not be performed. Recovery requires console/provider intervention to add `antrieb` to `remote-access` or temporarily remove `AllowGroups remote-access`.
actions_performed: Retried the only permitted node-control path three times; authentication remained blocked.
Did not claim restart persistence because node1 could not safely be restarted or inspected afterward.

evidence.summary: Captured boot ID 192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2; sshd was active, configuration syntax was valid, and port 22 was listening.
Confirmed `remote-access` exists and `opsadmin` has supplementary membership in it.
The candidate containing `AllowGroups remote-access` passed `sshd -t`, was installed, and sshd successfully reloaded while remaining active.
Every post-change execution attempt was rejected as `antrieb`; therefore no corrective command, post-change inspection, or restart could run.
Only the healthy baseline and original boot identity were captured. There is no restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, or post-restart recovery evidence.
